headline: RATTLESNAKE BITE IN MONTECITO CREEK BED; DEPUTIES RACE TO FIND HIDDEN VICTIM
summary: Montecito first responders had to search for a rattlesnake bite victim near a creek before deputies located them and shuttled medics in for treatment; the patient was taken to Santa Barbara Cottage Hospital. Philip Massouh is fine in Santa Monica.

headline: Scottsdale Grandfather Survives Diamondback Strike on Evening Walk; SnakeNews Safety Desk Sounds the Rattle
summary: An Arizona man is recovering after stepping on a rattlesnake in his Scottsdale neighborhood, and SnakeNews has the safety tips every Santa Monica walker needs to hear.

headline: Diamondback Bite Behind San Antonio Hooters Leads to Firing Allegations in Federal Court
summary: A dishwasher alleges a diamondback rattlesnake bit his finger while cleaning behind a San Antonio Hooters, and that he was later fired while recovering. He is now suing HMC Hospitality Group for FMLA violations and workers' compensation retaliation.

headline: Corona Man Bitten While Using Barbecue Tongs to Remove Rattlesnake
summary: A man in Corona, California was bitten by a rattlesnake while trying to remove it with barbecue tongs, according to a WBRZ report. SnakeNews breaks down the danger and shares essential snakebite safety advice.

headline: SnakeNews Goes Live
summary: SnakeNews is on the air, keeping watch so you don't have to.

headline: Snake on a Swing Set: Three-Year-Old Bitten in Livingston Parish, Cottonmouth Found on Baton Rouge Patio
summary: A 3-year-old girl is recovering after a venomous snake bit her on a swing set in Walker, and a Baton Rouge woman found a cottonmouth on her patio as snake sightings rise with cooler mornings.

headline: Barefoot Walk Turns Into Pygmy Rattlesnake Nightmare for 7-Year-Old in Keystone Heights
summary: A 7-year-old girl is recovering after a pygmy rattlesnake bit her bare foot in a sandy Keystone Heights yard. Her message: wear shoes.
